content:
Any avid 9to5Toys reader already knows how much we love us some Nomad around here. The brand has been delivering some of the best iPhone cases anywhere for years, and the new iPhone 18 Pro collection is no exception. They are, however, not often discounted in the first few months of release, unless you have our exclusive Nomad promo code – use code 9TO5MAC at checkout to knock 15% off any of the brand’s new iPhone 18 Pro cases.

Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Cases – Exclusive discount code

***Note: Use code 9TO5MAC at checkout to redeem the exclusive prices below. Only the iPhone 18 Pro/Max cases are eligible here – no iPhone Duo.

  • Modern Camino Leather Case $58 (Reg. $69)
  • Modern Horween Leather Case $67 (Reg. $79)
  • Traditional Camino Leather Case$67 (Reg. $79)
  • Traditional Horween Leather Case $75 (Reg. $89)
  • Mag Leather Back $50 (Reg. $59)
  • Rugged Case $58 (Reg. $69)
  • Clear Leather Case $58 (Reg. $69)
  • Sport Case $46 (Reg. $55)

Just remember you can also score 20% off a screen protector with the purchase of most Nomad cases right now – be sure to add both to the same cart.

I love Nomad’s Traditional Leather Case with leather wrapping right around the side of the cases and well as the two-tone Modern Leather model and had a chance to test out the limited edition burgundy treatment with the matching iPhone 18 Pro this year – it is still just as great as it has always been.

The brand also introduced some all-new Rugged Cases this year with a sort of topographical Baja California design that actually looks much better in person than it does on the site:

You can get a closer look at the 2026 Nomad iPhone 18 Pro collection in our launch coverage here, just be sure to take the discount code above with you.
